entities.summary: Aoi Aso Shrine  is a Shinto shrine in Hitoyoshi, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. It is colloquially known as Aoi-san (青井さん). It was originally established as a prefectural shrine, but is currently designated as a national shrine . Five of the structures within the shrine are listed as National Treasures of Japan.
